brief.title: Biomedical Research Landscape 2024–2026: Publication Trends, Topic Dynamics, and Open Access Patterns
brief.one_liner: A comprehensive trend analysis of 126,832 biomedical research abstracts indexed in PubMed from 2024 to early 2026, examining temporal publication patterns, geographic contributions, dominant research topics, and open-access adoption.
brief.goal: Equip research policy analysts and funding strategists with a clear picture of how biomedical research output is evolving across time, geography, and subject matter — highlighting emerging topics, shifts in open-access publishing, and collaboration patterns to inform strategic planning and resource allocation.

required_sections.title: Publication Volume & Temporal Distribution
required_sections.objective: Analyze the monthly and yearly distribution of publications, noting the natural skew toward 2024 due to PubMed indexing lag. Present volume trends over time and discuss seasonality or acceleration patterns.

required_sections.title: Geographic Landscape of Biomedical Research
required_sections.objective: Identify the top contributing countries by publication count, examine how geographic contributions shift over the 2024–2026 window, and highlight any emerging or declining national research presences.

required_sections.title: Research Topic & MeSH Keyword Analysis
required_sections.objective: Examine the most prevalent major topics and MeSH keywords, identify trending or emerging research areas across the time period, and note any topic shifts between years.

required_sections.title: Open Access Adoption & Journal Landscape
required_sections.objective: Quantify the proportion of open-access vs. closed-access publications, identify leading journals by volume, and assess whether open-access rates are changing over time or vary by country and research type.

required_sections.title: Research Type Distribution & Collaboration Indicators
required_sections.objective: Break down publications by research type (Journal Article, Review, Case Report, Systematic Review, Preprint), analyze author count distributions as a proxy for collaboration intensity, and explore how these vary by geography and topic.

required_sections.title: Key Takeaways & Strategic Implications
required_sections.objective: Synthesize the most important findings into actionable insights for research policy, funding prioritization, and institutional strategy.

kpis.name: Total Publications
kpis.description: Total number of biomedical abstracts in the dataset, broken down by year.

kpis.name: Open Access Rate
kpis.description: Percentage of publications flagged as open access (available via PMC), tracked over time.

kpis.name: Median Authors per Publication
kpis.description: Median number of authors per article, used as a proxy for collaboration intensity.

kpis.name: Top 10 Countries Share
kpis.description: Percentage of total publications contributed by the top 10 countries by volume.

kpis.name: Emerging Topic Growth Rate
kpis.description: Month-over-month growth in publication counts for the fastest-growing major MeSH topics.
